rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a person who tends a garden or grows plants.

example.english: This book introduces a famous gardener.
example.traditional: 呢本書介紹一位出名嘅園丁。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 syu1 gaai3 siu6 jat1 wai6 ceot1 meng2 ge3 jyun4 ding1

rows.note: Use this natural colloquial description when emphasizing someone who grows or looks after flowers and plants.

example.english: My mother often says that I am a gardener.
example.traditional: 我阿媽成日話我係種花嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 hai6 zung3 faa1 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a professional worker employed to maintain gardens or other planted grounds.

example.english: That gardener is responsible for maintaining the flower beds in the park every day.
example.traditional: 嗰位園藝工人每日負責打理公園入面啲花圃。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 jyun4 ngai6 gung1 jan4 mui5 jat6 fu6 zaak3 daa2 lei5 gung1 jyun2 jap6 min6 di1 faa1 pou2
